title: A CRAWLER THAT CATCHES YOU HANGS ON
why: His order of 2026-10-12: a crawler that catches you should keep hurting you until it is killed; it felt too lenient. Measured on the old build with one crawler touching a player on full health: standing still it bit every 0.7 seconds (9 bites in 6 seconds), but walking away it bit once in 6 seconds, because a walk is a little faster than a crawler and it trailed behind and never touched him again; sprinting it bit once and lost him; rolling it did no damage at all, because the one bite landed inside the roll and the roll immunity ate it. Now a crawler that touches you latches on: it stays at your side whether you walk, sprint or roll and keeps biting every 0.7 seconds until you kill it. The bite and its rate are unchanged (one crawler still takes about 5 seconds to kill a man on full health with no armour), so this is a balance change only in that you cannot outwalk it any more. A latched bite lands through the roll on purpose: the roll dodges what is coming, it is not a way out of something already on you. Going down still stops the biting, as before, and the 2 seconds after a revive still protect you; a wall between you makes it let go. Two or three can hang on at once, and each is still out in the world to be shot, knifed or fragged. Player 2 gets the same, through the host. DEMO and CAREER the same.
now: A crawler that catches you hangs on and keeps biting until you kill it. Walking, sprinting and rolling no longer shake it off.
